news.headline: Travis Kalanick kicks off another round of VC bashing: ‘1% are helpful’
news.summary: Travis Kalanick just raised $1.7B for robotics startup Atoms—and used the moment to critique his own industry. The Uber founder says only 1% of VCs are actually helpful, suggesting most add little value beyond capital.

news.headline: Fed officials saw need for rate hike if inflation doesn't cool, minutes show
news.summary: Fed officials signaled readiness to hike rates if inflation fails to moderate, according to minutes from their late July meeting. The discussion underscores persistent concern about price pressures even as the central bank weighs economic slowdown risks.

educational.title: What Is Bitcoin's 'Halving' and Why Does It Matter?
points: Roughly every 4 years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half by design
This slows how fast new bitcoin enters circulation, capping supply growth
It's baked into the code — no company or person decides when it happens
Historically, halvings have preceded major price cycles, though it's not guaranteed
The last coin will ever be mined around the year 2140 due to this schedule
